title: "He's Gonna Get Jumped" - TV Host Boxes Multiple Robots At Once, Beats Them Back To Silicon Valley
key_facts: French TV host Cyril Hanouna boxed two humanoid robots, Bob and Leo, in a segment of the French programme Tout Beau Tout Neuf
The robots were programmed to fight; one wore red headgear and gloves, the other blue
Hanouna kicked and punched the robots, knocking each to the floor more than once before a bell ended the bout
Clips of the segment are spreading on social media, with Instagram users joking the robots will remember the humiliation
Distractify compares the bots to Chinese humanoid models often seen malfunctioning in viral videos
The article contrasts it with influencer LaPenna, who lost a cage fight to a human-piloted humanoid built by REK
quote_evidence: The on-air personality squared off against Bob and Leo, two humanoid robots who were programmed to engage in fisticuffs.
It walks the host down, only to be met with another thunderous right that causes it to faceplant on the floor
"They will come after him first when they take over," one Instagram user penned.
why_it_matters_hint: A light reminder that today's humanoid robots still lose balance easily and are far from the sci-fi fighters social media jokes about
event_date: not stated; clips trending around 3-4 Oct 2026
notes: Distractify is an entertainment site describing viral clips; the segment date and robot maker are not stated.
